hypothesis: Verify translate_famous_landmark enforces full-term exact matching in Step 1, excludes chain brands from instant landmark data, preserves area prefix in Step 2 substring brand matching with display_name=None, skips Step 3 fuzzy lookup for facility/food intent queries, and restricts Step 4 Disney matching to exact park queries without unintended substring hijacking.

Verify cjk_text_similarity handles empty inputs, ordered subsequences, short subset discounts, and multi-bigram recall without index errors or score inversion, and verify rerank_top_k applies monotonic cross-script flooring (0.65), per-source _batch_rank importance scaling (stripping internal _batch_rank on output), and temple vs transit stop category weights without mutating caller candidate dicts.

Verify _extract_clean_place_query, _detect_city_prefix_anchor, and resolve_fusion_anchor_coords use bounded, ReDoS-safe regular expressions, reject non-finite or out-of-range coordinates, never return hardcoded Tokyo defaults when anchor inputs are absent, and avoid stripping valid short place names below 2 characters.

Verify smart_geocode_logic INSTANT RETURN requires full-distance exact landmark match, excludes chain brands, blocks bare HOMONYM_GUARD_KEYS when coordinates are missing or >80km away, and prevents polluted landmark search terms from leaking into downstream search_queries.

Verify geocode_search skips smart_search fusion when resolve_fusion_anchor_coords returns (None, None), handles malformed or missing coordinates safely in fusion payloads, deduplicates merged results by normalized name + <50m without invoking rerank_top_k a second time on base_list, and enforces positive body.limit bounds.

Verify _soft_filter_overpass_pois safely handles None/empty keywords, non-string fields, and falls back gracefully to original Overpass POIs when all entries are unmatched without throwing TypeError or returning empty lists unexpectedly.

Verify Edge Shield strips Content-Length and Content-Encoding before forwarding re-serialized JSON bodies, isolates macro zoom (round(zoom)<=10) in cache keys, bypasses caching when Gemini API keys or ArcGIS sources are present, and writes clean cache headers without Set-Cookie or stale Content-Encoding.

Verify extractCleanPlaceQuery, extractPlaceParentheticalNote, normalizeOsmType, and dedupeGeocodeResults avoid regex catastrophic backtracking, avoid shared stateful RegExp.lastIndex mutation, handle NaN/missing coordinates safely, and distinguish same osm_id across different osm_type values.

Verify ActivityEditModal cleanup useEffect strictly depends on [isOpen, editItem?.id], aborts in-flight geocode requests on close/item switch/unmount, guards stale responses with requestSeqRef and activeItemIdRef, omits limit (never limit:5 or limit:null), and only preserves extracted parenthetical remarks into desc when latest.desc is blank.

Verify itinerary-view handleSaveEdit passes calculateBiasLocation(day) to geocodeApi.search, enforces a 3500ms AbortController timeout without leaking timers (always cleared in finally), and does not block activity saving when geocoding aborts or fails.
